__broaden__.πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv. · also a preposition + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ Νέστορα) · also preverb in tmesis (πὰρ … θῆκεν = παρέθηκε ’set before’)
__broaden__.μῆρ: μηρός (pl. μῆρα) — thigh; sacrificial thigh-piece wrapped in fat and burned to a god; neut. acc. pl., elided (μῆρ’ = μῆρα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject, same form: ’the thigh-pieces’ (κατὰ μῆρ’ ἐκάη ’were burned’)
__broaden__.οἷς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’ (μετὰ οἷς ἑτάροισι ’among his own companions’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; masc./neut. dat. pl. (οἷς ἔπι ’on which’, of the stones)
__broaden__.οὖρος: οὖρος — a fair wind, favorable wind; masc. nom. sg. · also a different word, related to ὁράω ’see, watch’ — warden, guardian; masc. nom. sg. (οὖρος Ἀχαιῶν ’warden of the Achaeans’)
__broaden__.τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’)
__broaden__.φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with φρονέω: ’with friendly thoughts, kindly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’dear’ (τέκνα φίλα ’dear children’)
__broaden__.ἄγ: ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἄγ’ = ἄγε): ’he led’ · also ἄγε (elided ἄγ’), the interjection ’come!’, 2 sg. imper., used even to a group: ’come, come now’
__broaden__.ὅπλ: ὅπλον — tool, gear; pl. ship’s tackle and rigging (not weapons here); neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅπλ’ = ὅπλα) · also tools, implements of any craft (ὅπλα χαλκήια ’bronze tools’, of a smith)
__broaden__.λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl., governed by ἄνασσε ’was lord over’ · also gen. with a noun: ’of the people’ (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’)
__broaden__.αἰπὺ: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄρος · also with other neut. nouns (αἰπὺ πτολίεθρον ’steep citadel’)
__broaden__.κεχάροιτο: χαίρω — rejoice; perf. opt. 3 sg., reduplicated (κεχάροιτο), potential: ’would rejoice’ · also in a purpose clause after a past tense, ’might rejoice’ (ἵνα … κεχάροιτο); the form is usu. classed as a reduplicated aor. mid. opt.
__broaden__.ἴτω: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let her go’ · also of a man: ’let him go’
